narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#3547 (tracker, child C -- defect 3)

## What to build

`content/strategies/probe.md` still `!`-mandates deleted `scripts/probe_session.py` (start / complete / guard-artifact / guard-plan-registration / record) and `⊗` proceeding without it. The guard was ported to TypeScript (`packages/core/src/orchestration/probe-session.ts`) and is dispatched as `deft probe-session` (hyphen) via `packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts`. There is no `task probe:session` / `probe:session` colon verb.

Engine error strings still teach the Python file (five sites). `strategy_chaining.test.ts` fail-closes on the deleted script (`:201` / `:218`).

The probe **skill** (`content/skills/deft-directive-probe/SKILL.md`) is already xbrief-first and names no mechanical CLI guard. `/deft:run:probe` is the only `run:*` verb with `dispatchKind: "skill"` -- that path never hits the Python MUST. Thin direction is **strategy-side**: do not add a new mandate to the live skill surface.

Land **one PR**: strategy pack / `probe.md` + engine teach-strings + inverted content-contract tests + skill-strategy agreement. No weaken-the-test-first leaf (#3156). Do not bundle the rest of the strategy corpus (child D).

Cite (origin/master): `content/strategies/probe.md:76-99`, `:148`; `packages/core/src/orchestration/probe-session.ts:300,334,352,376,386-387`; `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/strategy_chaining.test.ts:201,218`; `packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts:109`; `REFERENCES.md:88`.

## Locked decisions (this child)

- Strategy-side: `probe.md` MUST-write / guard-artifact paths use the skill's `xbrief/` layout (probe surface only).
- Skill does not gain a new `deft probe-session` MUST. Both surfaces carry an explicit waiver: skill keeps the no-artifact guard; strategy names `deft probe-session`. Silence is not agreement.
- One discoverability remediation: update the existing Skills Index row (`REFERENCES.md:88`) so it teaches the hyphen verb `deft probe-session`. Do not add a `task` alias. Do not treat the current index row as already done -- it exists and does not teach the verb.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `probe.md` (and strategies pack source) no longer names `scripts/probe_session.py`; MUST paths are `xbrief/` and `deft probe-session`
- [ ] `probe-session.ts` error strings teach `deft probe-session`, not the Python file
- [ ] `strategy_chaining.test.ts` asserts the live contract in the **same PR** (no prior PR that only retargets the test)
- [ ] Skill and strategy disagree in prose only via the explicit waiver above
- [ ] Skills Index row teaches `deft probe-session`
- [ ] Close when a consumer deposit / next `directive update` would show the new text (`packs:render`). Not a publish-blocking release gate on this PR
- [ ] All new tests pass
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately. Preferred after A/B by tracker order. Must land before child D. Do not bundle with D.

## Out of scope

- Corpus-wide `vbrief/` MUST-write migration (child D)
- Optional layout-wide "named scripts/verbs resolve" ratchet (D tail)
- Making the probe skill the sole SoT and stubbing `strategies/probe.md`
narratives.UserStory: As an agent running probe, I want strategy docs and engine errors to name deft probe-session on xbrief paths, so that I am not told to invoke a deleted Python file.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update the probe strategy file and strategies pack module so MUST paths name xbrief/ and deft probe-session. 2. Change probe-session.ts error strings and the strategy_chaining test file in the same PR; teach REFERENCES.md Skills Index. 3. Add tests that verify the live contract and run packs:render as evidence.

narrative.Acceptance: When an agent reads probe.md, MUST paths name xbrief/ and deft probe-session; the document rejects scripts/probe_session.py.
When probe-session fails, error strings show deft probe-session and reject the deleted Python file.
When strategy_chaining tests run they validate the live contract in the same PR; the Skills Index row shows deft probe-session; the skill keeps the no-artifact guard and records an explicit waiver.
When packs:render and task check run they return exit 0; CHANGELOG Unreleased records the fix.
